1.w: The godly perish, but no one cares. Honest people disappear, when no one minds that the godly disappear because of evil.

2.w: Those who live uprightly enter a place of peace; they rest on their beds.

3.w: “But approach, you sons of omen readers, you offspring of adulteresses and prostitutes!

4.w: At whom are you laughing? At whom are you opening your mouth and sticking out your tongue? You are the children of rebels, the offspring of liars,

5.w: you who inflame your lusts among the oaks and under every green tree, who slaughter children near the streams under the rocky overhangs.

6.w: Among the smooth stones of the stream are the idols you love; they, they are the object of your devotion. You pour out liquid offerings to them, you make an offering. Because of these things how can I relent from judgment?

7.w: On every high, elevated hill you prepare your bed; you go up there to offer sacrifices.

8.w: Behind the door and doorpost you put your symbols. Indeed, you depart from me and go up and invite them into bed with you. You purchase favors from them; you love their bed, and gaze longingly on their naked bodies.

9.w: You take olive oil as tribute to your king, along with many perfumes. You send your messengers to a distant place; you go all the way to Sheol.

10.w: Because of the long distance you must travel, you get tired, but you do not say, ‘I give up.’ You get renewed energy, so you don’t collapse.

11.w: Whom are you worried about? Whom do you fear, that you would act so deceitfully and not remember me or think about me? Because I have been silent for so long, you are not afraid of me.

12.w: I will denounce your so-called righteousness and your deeds, but they will not help you.

13.w: When you cry out for help, let your idols help you! The wind blows them all away, a breeze carries them away. But the one who looks to me for help will inherit the land and will have access to my holy mountain.”

14.w: He says, “Build it! Build it! Clear a way! Remove all the obstacles out of the way of my people!”

15.w: For this is what the high and exalted one says, the one who rules forever, whose name is holy: “I dwell in an exalted and holy place, but also with the discouraged and humiliated, in order to cheer up the humiliated and to encourage the discouraged.

16.w: For I will not be hostile forever or perpetually angry, for then man’s spirit would grow faint before me, the life-giving breath I created.

17.w: I was angry because of their sinful greed; I attacked them and angrily rejected them, yet they remained disobedient and stubborn.

18.w: I have seen their behavior, but I will heal them. I will lead them, and I will provide comfort to them and those who mourn with them.

19.w: I am the one who gives them reason to celebrate. Complete prosperity is available both to those who are far away and those who are nearby,” says the Lord , “and I will heal them.

20.w: But the wicked are like a surging sea that is unable to be quiet; its waves toss up mud and sand.

21.w: There will be no prosperity,” says my God, “for the wicked.”
